front_blocks.md: A business can only ever operate in one sector of industry.

back_blocks.md: Some businesses **operate across more than one sector** — e.g. Shell **extracts** (primary), **refines** (secondary) and **sells** (tertiary) fuel.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

A business can only ever operate in one sector of industry.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

Some businesses **operate across more than one sector** — e.g. Shell **extracts** (primary), **refines** (secondary) and **sells** (tertiary) fuel.
